notes: Short lines used by the game (journal, loading screens, mid-battle barks). Kept deliberately brief. Chapter = book chapter.

q_labyrinth.speaker: feyre
q_labyrinth.text: The forest had become a labyrinth of snow and ice.

q_ribs.speaker: feyre
q_ribs.text: I'd turned gangly by this time of the year, and could count a good number of my ribs.

q_just_animal.speaker: feyre
q_just_animal.text: Animal, I reassured myself. Just an animal.

q_running.speaker: feyre
q_running.text: If he was a faerie, I should already be running.

q_silent.speaker: feyre
q_silent.text: The forest went silent. The wind died. Even the snow paused.

q_shuddered.speaker: feyre
q_shuddered.text: The arrow found its mark in his side, and I could have sworn the ground itself shuddered.

q_winter.speaker: feyre
q_winter.text: But this was the forest, and it was winter.

q_hope.speaker: father
q_hope.text: We need hope as much as we need bread and meat.

q_vow.speaker: feyre
q_vow.text: Stay together, and look after them.

q_love_belly.speaker: feyre
q_love_belly.text: Love won't feed a hungry belly.

q_immortal_light.speaker: acolyte
q_immortal_light.text: May the Immortal Light shine upon thee, sisters.

q_woods.speaker: mercenary
q_woods.text: Don't go far into the woods.

q_make_a_name.speaker: father
q_make_a_name.text: You go somewhere new—and you make a name for yourself.

q_prison.speaker: feyre
q_prison.text: My prison or my salvation—I couldn't decide which.

q_stay.speaker: suriel
q_stay.text: Stay with the High Lord, human.

q_happiest.speaker: feyre
q_happiest.text: It was the happiest moment of my life.

q_better_world.speaker: feyre
q_better_world.text: There is a better world out there.

q_fond_of_faeries.speaker: nesta
q_fond_of_faeries.text: Don't bother. I don't think I'd be particularly fond of faeries.
